TIS.BaseTokensHint: Tokens per combatant = base + Init, minimum 0. Default: 2. Changes apply when the bag is next refilled
TIS.CountHint: Remaining tokens / tokens at round start
TIS.LfgInit: Init from the LFG character sheet
TIS.ActiveGM: The active Foundry GM operates the bag.
